body.purpose: Vietnamese prose and default interface copy.

figure-lg.purpose: Primary symbol and price figures in the inspector.

ticker-chip.purpose: Compact company symbols in article metadata and navigation chips.

media-symbol-lg.purpose: Ticker fallback when a large news image is unavailable.

shadows.name: composer
shadows.purpose: Docked composer over a scrolling transcript.

motion.name: reduced-motion

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single filled amber action allowed in a view.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { height: 36px; padding: 8px 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 10px; background: hsl(var(--primary, 30 91% 58%)); color: hsl(var(--primary-foreground, 210 6% 7%)); font: 500 0.86rem/1.25rem Inter, Arial, sans-serif; transition: filter 200ms; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.1); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid hsl(var(--ring, 30 91% 58%)); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { filter: brightness(0.94); }

components.name: Primary Action Button
components.description: The shared 40px high-emphasis action used at panel and view edges.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary-action { height: 40px; padding: 8px 14px; border: 0; border-radius: 10px; background: hsl(var(--primary, 30 91% 58%)); color: hsl(var(--primary-foreground, 210 6% 7%)); font: 500 0.86rem/1.25rem Inter, Arial, sans-serif; transition: filter 200ms; } .ds-btn-primary-action:hover { filter: brightness(1.1); } .ds-btn-primary-action:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid hsl(var(--ring, 30 91% 58%)); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary-action:active { filter: brightness(0.94); } .ds-btn-primary-action:disabled { pointer-events: none; opacity: 0.5; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: A quiet secondary action that gains only a neutral wash.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { height: 36px; padding: 8px 16px; border: 1px solid hsl(var(--border, 220 4% 16%)); border-radius: 10px; background: transparent; color: hsl(var(--ink-3, 216 6% 83%)); font: 500 0.86rem/1.25rem Inter, Arial, sans-serif; transition: background-color 200ms, color 200ms; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: hsl(var(--foreground, 0 0% 98%) / 0.06); color: hsl(var(--foreground, 0 0% 98%)); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid hsl(var(--ring, 30 91% 58%)); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Icon Button
components.description: Compact accessible chrome control for the shell.
components.html: <button class="ds-icon-button" aria-label="Tìm kiếm"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="11" cy="11" r="7"></circle><path d="m20 20-3.5-3.5"></path></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-icon-button { width: 30px; height: 30px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: transparent; color: hsl(var(--ink-5, 214 4% 65%)); transition: background-color 200ms, color 200ms; } .ds-icon-button svg { width: 17px; height: 17px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.6; stroke-linecap: round; } .ds-icon-button:hover { background: hsl(var(--foreground, 0 0% 98%) / 0.06); color: hsl(var(--foreground, 0 0% 98%)); } .ds-icon-button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid hsl(var(--ring, 30 91% 58%)); }

components.name: Raised Evidence Card
components.description: A tonal content surface with one hairline and no shadow.
components.css: .ds-card { padding: 14px; border: 1px solid hsl(var(--border, 220 4% 16%)); border-radius: 14px; background: hsl(var(--surface-raised, 220 5% 12%)); color: hsl(var(--ink-2, 220 6% 90%)); font: 400 0.9rem/1.3rem Inter, Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-card-label { display: block; margin-bottom: 6px; color: hsl(var(--ink-6, 214 3% 56%)); font-size: 0.7rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.08em; } .ds-card strong { display: block; color: hsl(var(--ink-1, 0 0% 98%)); font: 500 1.1rem/1.3 JetBrains Mono, monospace; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-card p { margin: 6px 0 0; color: hsl(var(--positive, 140 50% 50%)); }

components.name: Composer Field
components.description: One lifted shell containing the message field and actions.
components.css: .ds-composer { display: flex; align-items: flex-end; gap: 10px; padding: 12px 14px 10px; border: 1px solid hsl(var(--border, 220 4% 16%)); border-radius: 18px; background: hsl(var(--surface-sunken, 220 4% 13%)); box-shadow: 0 20px 50px rgba(0,0,0,.45); } .ds-composer textarea { min-height: 26px; flex: 1; resize: none; border: 0; outline: 0; background: transparent; color: hsl(var(--foreground, 0 0% 98%)); font: 400 0.98rem/1.5 Inter, Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-composer textarea::placeholder { color: hsl(var(--ink-6, 214 3% 56%)); } .ds-composer button { width: 34px; height: 34px; border: 0; border-radius: 50%; background: hsl(var(--foreground, 0 0% 98%)); color: hsl(var(--background, 210 6% 7%)); transition: transform 150ms, filter 150ms; } .ds-composer button:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); filter: brightness(1.1); } .ds-composer button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid hsl(var(--ring, 30 91% 58%)); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-sr-only { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; overflow: hidden; clip: rect(0,0,0,0); }

components.name: Navigation Row
components.description: Dense sidebar navigation with a quiet neutral hover.
components.css: .ds-nav-row { width: 100%; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 8px 10px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: transparent; color: hsl(var(--ink-2, 220 6% 90%)); font: 400 0.9rem/1.3rem Inter, Arial, sans-serif; text-align: left; transition: background-color 200ms, color 200ms; } .ds-nav-row svg { width: 17px; height: 17px; fill: none; stroke: hsl(var(--ink-4, 214 5% 71%)); stroke-width: 1.6; stroke-linecap: round; } .ds-nav-row:hover { background: hsl(var(--foreground, 0 0% 98%) / 0.045); color: hsl(var(--foreground, 0 0% 98%)); } .ds-nav-row:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid hsl(var(--ring, 30 91% 58%)); }

components.name: Context Chip
components.description: A compact amber-tinted chip for explicit analysis context.
components.css: .ds-context-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 4px 4px 4px 10px; border: 1px solid hsl(var(--primary, 30 91% 58%) / 0.3); border-radius: 8px; background: hsl(var(--primary, 30 91% 58%) / 0.09); color: hsl(var(--primary, 30 91% 58%)); font: 400 0.8rem/1.15rem JetBrains Mono, monospace; } .ds-context-chip button { width: 17px; height: 17px; border: 0; border-radius: 5px; background: transparent; color: inherit; } .ds-context-chip button:hover { background: hsl(var(--primary, 30 91% 58%) / 0.2); } .ds-context-chip button:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid currentColor; }

components.name: Floating Menu Item
components.description: A menu row on the only static surface that receives a strong shadow.
components.css: .ds-menu { min-width: 220px; padding: 6px; border: 1px solid hsl(var(--border, 220 4% 16%)); border-radius: 14px; background: hsl(var(--surface-menu, 220 4% 14%)); box-shadow: 0 26px 60px rgba(0,0,0,.65); } .ds-menu-item { width: 100%; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 8px 10px; border: 0; border-radius: 9px; background: transparent; color: hsl(var(--ink-2, 220 6% 90%)); font: 400 0.9rem/1.3rem Inter, Arial, sans-serif; text-align: left; } .ds-menu-item kbd { margin-left: auto; color: hsl(var(--ink-6, 214 3% 56%)); font: 400 0.74rem/1.05rem JetBrains Mono, monospace; } .ds-menu-item:hover { background: hsl(var(--foreground, 0 0% 98%) / 0.06); } .ds-menu-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid hsl(var(--ring, 30 91% 58%)); }

narrative.overview:
VisgniteAI is a precise, calm, serious workspace for people who need to inspect evidence rather than be entertained by market motion. Its dark-first surface feels like a purpose-built financial instrument: dense enough for comparison, quiet enough for sustained reading, and explicit about where attention belongs.

The system is evidence-led in both information and appearance. Tonal hierarchy, tabular figures, compact controls, and persistent contextual panels make the interface feel operational. It rejects casino energy, neon-fintech spectacle, generic AI glow, and decorative effects that compete with financial meaning.
keyCharacteristics: Cool, dark tonal surfaces with a coherent slate cast.
One rationed amber accent for the most important action or selected state.
Compact, comparison-friendly typography with a dedicated numeric face.
Stable, single-viewport workspace with contextual panels instead of page churn.
Restrained motion that explains arrival, progress, and spatial change.

rules.name: The Rationed Amber Rule
rules.body: Allow roughly one filled amber control per view. Amber is a scarce action signal, not decoration or body text.

rules.name: The Data Is Not Brand Rule
rules.body: Green, red, violet, gold, cyan, and widget blue carry market or chart meaning. Never reuse them merely to make a control vivid, and never rely on color alone to communicate the state.

rules.name: The Three Jobs Rule
rules.body: Newsreader addresses, Inter operates, and JetBrains Mono compares. Do not trade roles for novelty.

rules.name: The Vietnamese Is Native Rule
rules.body: Every loaded face must include the Vietnamese subset; mid-sentence fallback is a broken design, not a harmless optimization.

rules.name: The Tonal-First Rule
rules.body: Static content earns hierarchy through its surface step and one hairline. Shadow is reserved for real overlap.

dos: Do use the cool tonal ladder to express nesting and hierarchy.
Do reserve filled amber for the single most important action or selection.
Do render comparable figures in mono with tabular numerals.
Do preserve the Vietnamese market palette and accompany color with text.
Do keep sidebar, draft, transcript, and inspector context stable as views change.
Do disable nonessential motion under prefers-reduced-motion.
donts: Don't add casino-like glow, neon gradients, generic AI auroras, or ambient decoration that competes with evidence.
Don't use green or red as brand colors, or amber for ordinary body text.
Don't add shadows to static cards; shadows belong to floating surfaces.
Don't introduce a fourth type role or use Newsreader for routine UI copy.
Don't hide missing, stale, sample, or refused data behind color, hover, or an empty space.
Don't navigate away merely to reveal context that belongs beside the user's current task.
